change_summary: Stub stale tool-result payloads (keep last 4) in build_messages to stop resending large JSON blobs every turn.
reason_for_change: On long tasks (23 at $1.08, 54 at $0.95, 40+ turns), pass-through resends every prior get_order_details JSON blob on all subsequent turns, causing quadratic input-token growth. Compressing history by replacing older bulky tool-result payloads with a short stub while preserving all assistant/user decisions, tool-call metadata, and the most recent tool outputs cuts input tokens per turn most on high-turn tasks. Recent results stay intact so the model still has what it's actively reasoning over, holding success.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.6667 < floor 0.7283
hypothesis: The system prompt embeds the full domain_policy on every turn (harness is pass-through, no compression), so at 28.5 turns/task the policy is re-sent ~28 times; compressing history (dropping stale tool-result payloads while keeping decisions) will cut input tokens per turn.
